architecture_models.content:
# S1-020 Architecture Models
Closure is a conjunctive fail-closed gate over dependency, probe, freshness, identity, and coverage evidence.

feature_catalog.content:
# S1-020 Feature Catalog
Twenty active tickets and four parked items are accounted without status inflation.

independent_audit.content:
# S1-020 Independent Audit
Two process-separated auditors agree on 120 observations; 19/19 prior probes and dependencies pass.

mathematical_model.content:
# S1-020 Mathematical Model
Closure equals the conjunction of every hard gate; no score compensates a failed gate.

mental_model.content:
# S1-020 Mental Model
A ticket label is a claim; immutable evidence and adversarial replay decide closure.

ontology.content:
# S1-020 Ontology
Ticket, dependency, probe, open item, limitation, parked item, auditor, evaluation, and evidence pack are typed.

platform_plan.content:
# Scope
Close Stage 1 research evidence only; no product acceptance or production certification.
# Architecture
Use the canonical SQLite research series, evidence-pack/v3, immutable Git bindings,
hash-frozen inputs, independent probe replay, and an Obsidian projection as a cache.
# Workstreams
Preserve prior bounded findings; route production, legal, source-tail, and profile-C
rollout work through their explicit re-entry conditions.
# Milestones
M1 dependency/probe gate; M2 independent rerun; M3 canonical pack; M4 wiki check.
# Verification
Re-run 19 dependency checks, 19 ticket probe checks, 60 corpus cases twice, 256
sensitivity trials, canonical chain verification, and wiki-check.
# Risks
Same-host audit and inherited PASS_WITH_LIMITS evidence do not establish production.
# Open decisions
PARK-01 legal, PARK-02 source tail, PARK-03 production SLO, and PARK-04 profile-C
rollout remain parked until their recorded triggers are satisfied.

Independent audit complete; canonical research revision and wiki projection are the remaining publication steps.

Audit one immutable base, replay all 19 dependencies and probes, then canonicalize.

synthesis_and_gaps.content:
# S1-020 Synthesis And Gaps
Stage 1 is research-complete with limits; production, legal, mass-source, and rollout claims remain excluded.

limitations: The auditor role is process-separated and adversarial but is not an external human or independently operated model.
The run verifies the frozen 12-record queue only; it does not verify all 176 historical u records.
Canonical pages and metadata were reviewed live, but full third-party content was not archived in this repository.
The benchmark is a short single-process local SQLite/WAL baseline with deterministic arrivals and a small read handler, not production traffic.
Distributed worker count, external calls, revocation, fan-out, failover, and multi-region behavior remain unverified.
The auditor role is adversarial and process-separated but not an external human or independently operated model.
The 20 ms p95 value remains an internal target; no production SLO or customer commitment is authorized.
Bounded evidence: Alloy scopes are 3-5 atoms per command; the TLC model bounds are 2 grants, 1 decision, Alloc=3, MaxTick=4, MaxPub=2; no unbounded proof is claimed.
The simulator exercises the design contract (transactional outbox, fencing, reconciliation), not deployed production code; Core AgentOS does not yet implement the grant/outbox service.
Producer and verifier labels, and acceptance reruns, are process-separated in one local environment; they are not off-host or external human audits.
Executed on a Java 8 JRE with tla2tools 1.7.0 (TLC2 2.15); the current tla2tools 2.0 build requires Java 11+ and was not executed.
LIVE1/LIVE2 are bounded traces (tick model, simulator replay) plus design obligations for the implementation, not unbounded liveness proofs.
Stale-ack fencing is zero in random acceptance runs by construction and is evidenced deterministically by probe A duplicate-ack suppression and the SAF2 negative mutation.
Boundary measurements are same-host and bounded; multi-host partition semantics and orchestrator restart latencies are unknown and excluded from scoring (bounded in sensitivity S3).
The recommendation is a research decision for the MVP; it is not a production deployment, availability, or reliability claim.
S1-002 and S1-004 evidence is PASS_WITH_LIMITS and is reused only within its stated limits.
Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
The containers restart/recovery cell remains unknown until a bounded container prototype is measured (production deployments are out of scope for this ticket).

Model-based comparison on a same-host research station: durable-engine costs combine S1-005 E1/E2 measurements with documented lease/visibility assumptions (100 ms lease timeout, 105 ms modeled recovery); no vendor engine was installed.
Low/nominal arrival rates link to the S1-002 planning envelope; the 20,000/s high load is an explicit simulator saturation probe, not a production profile.
Multi-host partition behaviour and vendor timer semantics are unknown and excluded from scoring.
Migration triggers remain design obligations until a production-like follow-up benchmark measures them.
All results are local-model measurements from a deterministic stdlib-only simulation; no production latency, storage or privacy certification is claimed.

The timing probe is a bounded same-host paired-interleaved wall-clock measurement (200 paired samples x 32 inner repeats x 3 seeds per variant, tolerance max(10% of control median, 2000ns) recomputed by the evaluator from raw samples); it cannot prove absence of all side channels.
D9 (operational complexity/migration) and D11 (profile compatibility) are inference-type cells derived from the frozen contract, the current implementation and documented profiles.
Storage overhead uses a declared fixed per-index constant (256 bytes) - a model assumption, not a measurement of a production index engine.
S1-003 and S1-005 evidence is reused only within its stated limits (see dependency-gate.json).
Same-host model-only: no production network/cache topology tested.
Process-separated auditor, not an external/independent audit firm.
Local model cannot prove absence of all network/cache side channels.
Clock assumptions: monotonic clock authoritative for elapsed; UTC wall for audit only.
